In twenty fourteen, a tiny robot landed on a comet.
It bounced, and vanished into a dark crack.
Seven months later, it woke up and called home.
Its mothership searched for two years.
Instead of drifting off into space, the mothership came down to join it.
Nobody should be alone in the dark.
That's why we made Feeloy. Jenny's always there.
